title: [dev-e5] graphs stopped to be updated
body:
Sometime secondary graphs update is stopped see screenshots below: (I had this issue twice, last time this morning)
- 1st screenshot: this morning when I saw the issue
- Basal curve and all secondary graphs are "frozen" (only BG value and SMB remains updated
- If I change time range (see 2nd screenshot), curves remain frozen (no update of vertical scale, if time range is longer no update of curve for previous values, only horizontal scale is updated...)
- loop continue to works and NS is still updated
- if I restart AAPS, graphs are immediatly updated

![GraphsUpdate](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/120918752-4b9f2300-c6b6-11eb-9031-625c523039e7.jpg)


I can share my log if it can help...
